integrity: Complete symbolic graph-distance proof, reproducible stand-alone BFS-based exhaustive checks for n=2..11; the finite check is not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns two complete clique layers connected by a matching; it does not cover other graph products. Publication priority is not independently certified; a related mixed-metric research record was inspected at the indexed-summary level only.
title: Exact vertex-edge dominant edge-metric bases of complete prisms
